key_insight: HTSCGAN improves multi-modal brain MRI translation by explicitly preserving hierarchical tumor structure during image synthesis.
clinical_relevance: Better tumor-region fidelity in translated MRI could make synthetic images more useful for diagnosis support, treatment planning, and downstream segmentation.
method: Uses a generator with three Patch Contrast Modules at different patch sizes to capture tumor structure at multiple scales.
Adds a pretrained Patch Classifier to enforce patch-level structure consistency through classification loss.
Uses a pretrained Structure-Aware Encoder to guide tumor perceptual loss toward matching ground-truth tumor appearance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong results on BraTS2020 and BraTS2021 for both translation quality and downstream segmentation performance.
watch_item: Performance is reported from benchmark datasets, so real-world clinical robustness and generalization across scanners, sites, and tumor types still need validation.
paper_title: Unified MRI Brain Image Translation via Hierarchical Tumor Structure Comparison
